text.text_excerpt: This B&B was WONDERFUL. First, the owner Karen goes above and beyond (she even gives you a parting gift of creole seasoning before you leave!). She fills a generous basket with pastries (muffins, danishes, biscotties, etc.) for you each day. She had a book put together of places to eat, drink, sight see, and safety tips. We've never stayed at a B&B before I think we'll be hard pressed to find one as perfect at the Dauphine House. The location is also perfect. We didn't use our car once during our stay as it was right on the edge of the French Quarter. We felt perfectly safe as well in the neighborhood. The B&B has so much charm and character that it gives you a way more authentic NOLA exp...

Again we had the best time staying here! My husband swears it is one of the best beds he has ever slept in! The mini cinnamon rolls and red velvet cupcakes are to die for... The location is great because it is close to Frenchman Street and Bourbon Street. But the best feature of course is the owner Karen! She seriously is the nicest lady I have ever met. Whatever you need she will either get it you, or tell you how or where to get it. This is our spot to stay whenever we are in NOLA!!

Recently completed my third stay at Dauphine House (5 nights for French Quarter Fest 2013), and as always, Karen offered unbelievably wonderful service in for a very reasonable price in an ideal location between French Quarter and Frenchmen. She maintains her place beautifully, is the most promptly responsive business owner out there (totally on top of phone/email), and will go above and beyond to make your stay perfect. I prefer the street front room because it has a little porch and separate access outside the gate (note it is noisiest room), but I have stayed in all of the rooms and they each have advantages. She always accommodates my special requests around dietary preferences, etc. ...
